Definition
[Admissible class] ↗ def:coercivity-condition-lagrangian 1. ch8:8.2.1-def-2\group Existence of Minimizers

Set \[ \mathcal{A} := \{ w \in W^{1,q}(U) \mid w = g \text{ on } \partial U \text{ in the trace sense}\} \] as the class of admissible functions. By (4), $I[w]$ is defined in $\R \cup \{ +\infty \} $ for $w\in \mathcal A$.
